name: Pasta Tie Bow and Beef
description: A hearty pasta dish with sautéed beef, mushrooms, and red peppers, topped with Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb (340 g) sirloin steak, sliced into thin strips
1 red pepper, cut into ¾ inch squares

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta in boiling water with 1 tsp cooking oil and salt for about 12 minutes. Drain and keep warm.
Heat wok on medium-high. Add 1 Tbsp cooking oil and stir-fry beef strips until desired doneness. Transfer to bowl.
Add another 1 Tbsp cooking oil to the wok. Stir-fry mushrooms, red pepper, and crushed chilies for 2 to 3 minutes until tender.
Add beef back into the wok and heat through. Stir in Parmesan cheese.
Spread cooked pasta on a plate and spoon the beef mixture over top. Sprinkle with additional Parmesan cheese.

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Beef
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Pepper Chicken Fettucini
_similar.description: A colorful and flavorful chicken fettucini dish with sweet peppers, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 sweet red peppers, cut in strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms, and seasoning. Stir-fry over medium heat until chicken is cooked through.
Add hot cooked fettucini noodles and toss.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and toss. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza-inspired casserole with pasta, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine and sauté chopped onion until soft.
Add tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, and basil. Stir and remove from heat.
Cook pasta in boiling water with oil and salt for 8 to 10 minutes until tender but firm. Drain.
Combine cooked pasta with Parmesan cheese and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a 3-quart casserole.
Scatter pepperoni slices over the pasta mixture.
Cover with the tomato-onion sauce and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Bake, uncovered, in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.

_similar.keywords: pizza casserole, pasta bake, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.
